# Frozen pre-Capsule inputs

These are exact inputs of retained experiments, copied before the Capsule
rename. They are intentionally not rewritten with current field names.
Historical tests use them to verify original identities and measurements;
current conversion configurations remain under `src/config/conversion/`.

This archive is neither a public API nor runtime compatibility. New Capsules
require new signed identities and qualification. Do not use these snapshots to
claim that a pre-migration observation qualifies the current implementation.
